# Butler v0.0.20

## Hotfix

- Replaced the user-visible tool-round failure with internal execution
  windows. Long-running work now keeps the same Turn, model-loop history, and
  response lifetime until one final answer is ready, without asking the user
  to retry or continue.
- Preserved bounded physical provider retries and ordered backup-model fallback
  while separating those safety limits from the semantic work loop.
- Kept Stop, cancellation, and permanent provider failures terminal and
  truthful without creating a successor Turn or an intermediate delivery.

This release supersedes v0.0.19 for desktop and Agent installations.
